meals.title: Braai Boerewors & Chutney-Glazed Pork Chops with Foil Potatoes
meals.why: Boerewors and pork chops are both on special, and the cheap 2kg bag of potatoes bulks out the braai.
also_need: tomato and lettuce for a side salad
method: Slice the potatoes into wedges, toss with oil, salt and pepper, wrap in foil parcels with onion slices and put on the coals for about 35 minutes.
Mix 2 tbsp chutney with a little oil and brush it on the pork chops.
Braai the chops for 5-6 minutes per side, brushing with more glaze as they cook.
Braai the boerewors over medium coals for 15-20 minutes, turning once.
Rest the meat for 5 minutes and serve with the potatoes, salad and extra chutney.

meals.title: Butternut & Tomato Curry with Parboiled Rice
meals.why: Butternut is in season in the Cape and only R14.99/kg, and with rice and tinned tomatoes this feeds the family for very little.
method: Fry a chopped onion and garlic in oil until soft, then stir in 1-2 tbsp curry powder for a minute.
Add the tomato paste, chopped tomatoes and about 1 cup of water, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add peeled butternut cubes and simmer covered for 20-25 minutes until soft.
Cook the rice according to the packet.
Serve the curry over the rice with a spoon of cold yoghurt on top.

meals.title: Mi Goreng Noodles with Fried Egg & Veg
meals.why: At under R6 a pack, Indomie plus a couple of eggs from the 18-tray makes a filling dinner for very little.

uses.item: Indomie Mi Goreng Fried Instant Noodles 85g

method: Boil the noodles for 3 minutes, then drain and keep the seasoning sachets.
Stir-fry shredded cabbage and carrot in a hot pan for 2-3 minutes.
Toss the noodles into the pan with the Indomie sachets and a splash of soy sauce.
Fry an egg per person in a separate pan until the edges are crispy.
Top each bowl with an egg and sliced spring onion.

meals.title: Beef Mince Macaroni Bake
meals.why: Lean beef mince is on special at Checkers, and macaroni and tomato paste stretch it into a big oven dish that gives leftovers for lunch.
method: Preheat the oven to 190°C and cook the macaroni until just al dente.
Brown about 500g mince with onion and garlic, then add the tomato paste, chopped tomatoes and herbs, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Make a white sauce: melt 2 tbsp butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, whisk in 2 cups milk until thick, then add half the grated cheddar.
Mix the pasta into the mince sauce, put it in an ovenproof dish and pour the white sauce over.
Top with the remaining cheese and bake for 25-30 minutes until golden.

meals.title: Peri-Peri Chicken Livers on Toasted Panini
meals.why: Chicken livers are R21.50 for 500g, which makes this one of the cheapest proteins in the specials.
method: Thaw the livers in the fridge during the day, then pat dry.
Fry onion and garlic in oil until golden, then add the livers and fry on high heat for 4-5 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes and peri-peri sauce and simmer for 8-10 minutes until thick.
Split and toast the panini.
Spoon the livers over the panini and serve with a green salad.

meals.title: One-Tray Roast Chicken, Potato & Butternut Bake
meals.why: The 5kg braaipack works out far cheaper per portion than fresh chicken, and you can freeze what you don't use, while potatoes and butternut fill the tray.
method: Thaw about a third of the chicken pieces overnight in the fridge and refreeze the rest in portions.
Preheat the oven to 200°C and toss chopped potatoes and butternut in oil, paprika, garlic, salt and pepper in a large tray.
Nestle the chicken pieces on top, skin side up, and season well.
Roast for 50-60 minutes, brushing the chicken with chutney in the last 10 minutes.
Check that the chicken is cooked through and the juices run clear, then serve straight from the tray.
